## Trigger Conditions
The contract rejects the call when any of these registry conditions holds:
- `Branch::GovernanceAlreadyVetoed` — the proposal was vetoed and is dead.

## Minimal Reproduction

Focused regression test: [`contracts/streaming-payments/src/governance_test.rs::one_signer_can_veto_and_that_kills_the_proposal`](../../contracts/streaming-payments/src/governance_test.rs::one_signer_can_veto_and_that_kills_the_proposal). The matrix arm below is the smallest direct construction; `rejected!` records the fired branch and asserts its mapped code.

```rust
// GovernanceAlreadyVetoed — excerpt from error_surface_test.rs
let g = Governed::new();
let id = g.propose_fee(&g.a, 100);
g.f.client.mock_all_auths().governance_veto(&g.b, &id);
Some(rejected!(g
    .f
    .client
    .mock_all_auths()
    .try_governance_execute(&Address::generate(&g.f.env), &id)))
```

Run the focused test:

```bash
cargo test -p streampay-contract --locked one_signer_can_veto_and_that_kills_the_proposal
```

## User Remediation Guidance
> **Plain-Language Remediation**:  
> Create a new proposal; a vetoed proposal is permanently dead and cannot be signed, executed, or vetoed again.
>
> **Reference**: [`docs/POLICY_GOVERNANCE.md#1-governance-model`](../../docs/POLICY_GOVERNANCE.md#1-governance-model)
